meta.title: Add Turbopack support for faster development builds
meta.body_summary: Integrate --turbopack flag into Next.js dev servers in Procfiles for faster compilation (~564ms locally), while restoring --no-lint build flag after team feedback to preserve CI linting behavior.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added Turbopack to dev servers, then iterated on config reverts and --no-lint restoration per human review; merged after team consensus on flags.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 24 changed lines across 5 config files, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a configuration-level build performance optimization with low merge friction, consistent with the successful merge after brief team review.

review_details.concern_detail: The initial PR removed --no-lint from build scripts, which could enable linting and cause CI failures; cursor[bot] flagged this, and MayaRainer later confirmed --no-lint is a valid Next.js option to skip redundant linting, leading to its restoration.
review_details.performance_claim: Development server compilation time reduced to ~564ms with Turbopack.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Configuration change across multiple files (Procfiles, package.json, Next.js config, CI) requires knowledge of Next.js's --turbopack and --no-lint flags; Devin handled the iteration but needed human clarification on team-specific flag conventions.

detection_detail.code_reading: slavingia and cursor[bot] reviewed the diff, commenting on typedRoutes disabling and --no-lint flag validity; MayaRainer clarified that --no-lint is a valid Next.js option to save CI time.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body claims ~564ms dev compilation speed but provides no benchmark artifact; manual testing instructions exist but performance evidence is anecdotal.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After review comments, Devin restored --no-lint and reverted typedRoutes conditional disable within the same PR without revert.

core_change_summary.description: Added --turbopack to Next.js dev commands in Procfile.dev and Procfile.test; removed --turbopack from build command after discovering its instability; after team feedback, restored --no-lint flag in build commands and kept typedRoutes:true despite Turbopack warnings.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: package.json and CI workflow changes were incidental to restoring --no-lint flag per team convention; next.config.ts reverted typedRoutes to always-enabled after brief experimentation.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added --turbopack to dev and build commands.
Second commit: removed --turbopack from build (unsupported in Next.js 15).
Third commit: conditionally disabled typedRoutes for dev to avoid Turbopack warnings.
Fourth commit (slavingia): reverted typedRoutes to true per PR feedback.
Fifth commit: removed --no-lint flag from build scripts due to flag validity concerns.
Sixth commit (MayaRainer clarification): restored --no-lint as it is valid and saves CI time.

review_signals.summary: Requested reverting typedRoutes to always true instead of conditionally disabling in development.
review_signals.action_taken: Devin committed 9d61a38 to revert to typedRoutes: true.

review_signals.summary: Alerted that removing --no-lint could enable linting during builds, causing failures.
review_signals.action_taken: Initially removed --no-lint further, then restored after team feedback.

review_signals.summary: Questioned whether --no-lint is a valid Next.js flag, prompting team discussion.
review_signals.action_taken: MayaRainer confirmed validity, leading to restoration.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed --no-lint is a valid Next.js option used to save CI time by skipping redundant linting.
Explicit directive to add back the --no-lint flag.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with Turbopack integration, initially including --turbopack in build and removing --no-lint.
slavingia and cursor[bot] provided inline feedback on typedRoutes and --no-lint within minutes.
MayaRainer clarified --no-lint validity, and slavingia directed restoration of the flag.
Devin iterated through commits to address each comment; no CHANGES_REQUESTED block.
Merged within ~13.6 hours after team consensus.
